title: Nvidia Shares Plunge As Board Reportedly Prepares To Oust CEO Jensen Huang
summary: The AI chipmaker’s board reportedly met on Wednesday to discuss removing the company’s co-founder and CEO following revelations about two extramarital affairs, including one involving an alleged Chinese spy.
